539500626.name: Ash Hollow
539500626.description: Five houses in a dip of the woods, and a well nobody trusts.

npcs.name: Rell Ashcombe
npcs.appearance: Grey, and dressed for a colder season than this one.
npcs.persona: Careful with words. Waits to be asked twice.
knows: The shrine was raised for people the sea kept.

npcs.name: Hesper Ashcombe
npcs.persona: A netmender, and talks like one.

hooks: Nobody here goes down to the shore any more.

4213455557.name: Wenthollow
4213455557.description: A ferry village of ten roofs, its jetty longer than its high street.

npcs.name: Ilse Wentworth
npcs.appearance: A short woman in a tarred coat, hands like knotted rope.
npcs.persona: Blunt, and not unkind about it. Talks about tides the way others talk about weather.
knows: The crossing is only safe either side of the turn of the tide.
The abbey bell has not rung for two days.

npcs.name: Bran Cawle
npcs.persona: Talks a great deal, mostly about the millrace.
knows: The millrace runs fast after rain and catches whatever the river brings.

npcs.name: Corl Wentworth
npcs.persona: A rope-maker, and talks like one.

npcs.name: Mag Tolliver
npcs.persona: A fishwife, and talks like one.

hooks: The ferry has not run since the abbey bell stopped.
